questions.question: The value of (p²-(q-r)²)/((p+r)²-q²)+(q²-(p-r)²)/((p+q)²-r²)+(r²-(p-q)²)/((q+r)²-p²) is:
A dealer marks his goods at 20% above the cost price and allows a discount of 15%. What is his gain percentage?
questions.solution:
Given:

Marked price = 20% above the cost price

discount = 15%

Formula used:

Profit % = (Profit / Cost Price) x 100

Profit = SP - CP

Selling price = [1 - Discount% / 100] x MP

Solution:

Let the CP be 100.

Marked price = 100 + 20% of 100

= 120

Selling price = 120 * (100 - 15)%

= 102

Profit = 102 - 100

= 2

Profit % = (2 / 100) x 100

Hence, the **Profit %** is 2%.

questions.question: A one metre pipe is made with inner diameter equal to outer radius. How much material (in cubic units) is required to make the pipe, if it can hold (88)/(7) cubic metres water in it?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Internal Diameter = Outer radius

Let internal radius = r, outer radius = R, and h = height of pipe

so

2r = R

formula used:-

Volume of cylinder = π(R2 - r2)h

and

Water in pipe = Internal base area × h

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

Water in pipe = 88/7

πr² × h = 88/7

⇒ 22/7 × r² × 1 = 88/7

⇒ r = 2 m

so

R = 2 × 2 m = 4m

and

Material Used = Volume of Pipe

Material Used = π(R² - r²)h

⇒ 22/7 × (4² - 2²) × 1

⇒ 37.7 m³

**Hence option 1 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: A boat can cover 120 km upstream and back in a total of 30 hours, and 25 km upstream and 40 km downstream in a total of 7 hours. How much distance will the boat cover in 16 hours in still water?
questions.solution:
GIVEN:

A boat can cover 120 km upstream and back in a total of 30 hours.

A boat can cover 25 km upstream and 40 km downstream in a total of 7 hours.

FORMULA USED:

Distance = Speed × Time 

Speed in upstream = Speed of boat in still water - Speed in current water

Speed in downstream = Speed of boat in still water + Speed in current water 

CALCULATION:

Let the speed of the boat in still water be x km/h and the speed of the boat in current water be y km/h 

Speed in downstream = x + y , Speed in upstream = x - y 

Now, Distance/Speed = Time 

⇒ 120/(x +y) + 120/(x -y) = 30 .........(1)

Also,

⇒ 40/(x +y) + 25/(x -y) = 7 ...........(2)

Now, on multiplying eq(2) by 3 and subtracting eq(1) it from we get

⇒ 120/(x +y) + 120/(x -y) - 120/(x +y) - 75/(x -y) = 30 - 21

⇒ 45/( x -y) = 9

⇒( x -y) = 5 ..........eq(3)

Putting eq(3) in eq(1):

⇒ 120/(x +y) + 120/5 = 30 

⇒ 120/(x +y) = 30 - 24

⇒ (x +y) = 20 .......eq(4)

Solving both eq(3) and eq(4), we get:

⇒ x = 12.5

Distance the boat cover in 16 hours in still water = 12.5 × 16

⇒ 200 km.

**The distance the boat cover in 16 hours in still water is 200km.**

questions.question: During a school excursion each student of junior school was charged Rs. 325 and each student of senior school was charged Rs. 400. If there were 80 students from junior school and the combined average amount charged per student was Rs. 352, then how many students from senior school went for the excursion?
questions.solution:
**Calculation**

Let the number of students in senior school be a.

The total amount charged from students of junior school = 325 × 80

⇒ 26000

The total amount charged from students of senior school = 400 × a

⇒ 400a

The total amount charged from both the schools = (a + 80) × 352

⇒ (a + 80) × 352 = 2600 + 400a

⇒ 400a - 352a = 28160 - 26000

⇒ 48a = 2160 

⇒ a = 45.

**The number of students from the senior school who went on the excursion is 45.**

questions.question: A thief is noticed by a policeman from a distance of 500 m. The thief starts running and the policeman chases him. The thief and the policeman run at the rate of 17 km/h and 20 km/h, respectively. What is the distance between them after 8 minutes?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Relative speed in same direction = 20 − 17 = 3 km/h.

Convert relative speed to m/min = 3 × (1000/60) = 50 m/min.

Distance reduced in 8 minutes = 50 × 8 = 400 m.

Remaining distance = 500 − 400 = 100 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 100 m.**

**__Alternate Method__**

 
• 
 
 Policeman (P)
 20 km/h
 
 Thief (T)
 17 km/h
 

 Initial Gap = 500 m
 

 

 Relative Motion Diagram

Given:

Initial distance = 500 m

Speed of Policeman (Sₚ) = 20 km/h

Speed of Thief (Sₜ) = 17 km/h

Time (t) = 8 minutes

Formula used: Distance = Relative Speed × Time

Relative speed (same direction) = Sₚ − Sₜ

⇒ Relative speed = 20 − 17 = 3 km/h

⇒ Speed in m/min = (3 × 1000) ÷ 60 = 50 m/min

⇒ Distance covered in 8 minutes = 50 × 8 = 400 m

⇒ Distance between them after 8 minutes = Initial distance − Relative distance covered

⇒ Distance = 500 − 400 = 100 m

**∴ The correct answer is 100 m.**

**__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed Concept

When two objects move in the same direction, relative speed is the difference (S₁ − S₂). In opposite directions, it is the sum (S₁ + S₂).

Unit Conversion

To convert km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert km/h to m/min, multiply by 1000/60 or 50/3.

Catching Time

Time to catch = Initial Distance ÷ Relative Speed. The distance covered by policeman until catching = Sₚ × Catching Time.</p

questions.question: If the length of a chord, drawn at a distance of 21 cm from the centre of a circle, is 40 cm, then the radius (in cm) of the circle is:
questions.solution:
Given:

Chord = 40cm 

Distance from centre to chord = 21 cm

Concept:

The perpendicular drawn from the centre of the chord bisects the chord in two equal parts. 

Pythagoras Theorem:

OA² = OD² + AD²

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/331d4557693c23facd62eeb677f12903e75ed3ef6343024df77bfe01617fe79b.png] 

Let AB be the chord of length 40 cm. 

⇒ OD be the perpendicular distance 

⇒ AO be the radius of the circle 

OA2 = OD2 + AD2

⇒ OA2 = 212 + (40/2)²

⇒ OA2 = 441 + 400 

⇒ OA2= 841

OA = √841

OA = 29

**The radius (in cm) of the circle is 29.**

questions.question: Ankita sold her watch at 5% loss. If she had sold it for Rs. 300 more, she would have gained 5%. Find the selling price of the watch.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Difference in percentage = 5% profit − (−5% loss) = 10%

Difference in selling price = Rs. 300

So, 10% of Cost Price = Rs. 300 ⇒ 1% = Rs. 30

Original Selling Price = 95% of Cost Price

Original Selling Price = 95 × 30 = Rs. 2,850

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 2,850.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Loss percentage in the first case = 5%

Profit percentage in the second case = 5%

Difference in selling price = Rs. 300

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price at loss = CP × (100 − Loss%)/100

Selling Price at profit = CP × (100 + Profit%)/100

 

 Total Difference = Rs. 300 (10%)
 
 
• 
 
 
 
 
 
 Original SP
 Cost Price
 New SP
 
 95%
 100%
 105%
 
 

 5% Loss
 
 

 5% Profit

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the Cost Price (CP) of the watch be 100x.

⇒ Original Selling Price (SP₁) = 100x − 5% of 100x = 95x

⇒ New Selling Price (SP₂) = 100x + 5% of 100x = 105x

⇒ Difference in Selling Price = SP₂ − SP₁

⇒ 105x − 95x = 300

⇒ 10x = 300

⇒ x = 30

⇒ Original Selling Price = 95x = 95 × 30 = Rs. 2,850

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 2,850.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cost Price (CP) and Selling Price (SP)

Cost Price is the amount paid to purchase an article. Selling Price is the price at which the article is sold. Profit or loss is always calculated on the Cost Price unless stated otherwise.

Marked Price (MP)

It is the price on the label of an article. Discount is always offered on the Marked Price. Formula: SP = MP × (100 − Discount%)/100.

Successive Discounts

If two successive discounts of a% and b% are given, the effective net discount is given by the formula (a + b − ab/100)%.

questions.question: P takes twice as long as Q or three times as long as R to complete a task. If they work together, they can complete the task in two days. How long will it take Q to complete the task on his own?
questions.solution:
Given:

Time taken by P = Twice the time taken by Q

Time taken by P = Thrice the time taken by R

Formula used:

Efficiency = Total work/Time taken

Calculation:

Let the time taken by P be 6 units

⇒ Time taken by Q = 3 units

⇒ Time taken by R = 2 units

L.C.M of (2, 3 and 6) = 6 units (Total work)

⇒ Efficiency of P = 6/6 = 1 units/day

⇒ Efficiency of Q = 6/3 = 2 units/day

⇒ Efficiency of R = 6/2 = 3 unit/day

Total efficiency = (1 + 2 + 3) = 6 units/day

They complete the task in 2 days, 

Hence, total units of work = 6 × 2 = 12 units

Thus, Q takes total time,

⇒ 12/2 = 6 days

**It takes 6 days for Q to complete the task on his own.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

We know time is inversely proportional to efficiency.

So Ratio of efficiency 

⇒ P : Q : R = 1 : 2 : 3

Total work in 2 days = 12

Time take by Q = 12/2 = 6 days

A policeman chases a thief. The speeds of the policeman and the thief are 8 km/h and 6 km/h, respectively. If the policeman started 10 minutes late, at what distance he will catch the thief?
questions.solution:
Given:

Speed of thief = 6 km/h

Speed of policeman = 8 km/h

Formula Used:

Speed = Distance/Time

Concept Used:

If two objects are moving in the same direction with speeds S 1 and S 2 ,

Their relative speed is S 1 – S 2

Calculation:

Only the thief runs for 10 minutes.

Speed of thief in m/s = 6 km/h × 5/18 = 5/3 m/s

Time Taken in sec = 10 × 60 sec = 600 sec

Distance covered by the thief = Speed × Time

⇒ 5/3 m/s × 600 sec = 1000 m

Relative speed = 8 – 6 = 2 km/h

⇒ 2 × 5/18 m/s

⇒ 5/9 m/s

Time to catch the thief = Time required to cover 1000

⇒ 1000/5 × 9 s

⇒ 200 × 9 s

⇒ 1800 s = 30 min

Distance covered by the policeman in 30 min = 8 × 1/2

= 4 km.

∴ The policeman will catch the thief in 4 km.

questions.question: The rate at which a sum becomes four times of itself in 12 years at simple interest will be:
questions.solution:
Given:

Time = 12 years

The sum becomes four times of itself

Formula used:

Simple interest = (P × R × T)/100

Where P → Principal

T → Time

R → Rate

Calculation:

Let the principal be 'x'.

So, Amount = 4x

Simple interest = 3x

Simple interest = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ 3x = (x × R × 12)/100

⇒ R = (3 × 100)/12

⇒ R = 25%

**The annual rate of interest is 25%**.

questions.question: DE is a chord and KDE is a secant of a circle. If KD = 9 cm, DE = 7 cm and KH is a tangent to the circle at point H, then find KH.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

DE is the chord of a circle.

KD = 9 cm ; DE = 7 cm

**Concept used:**

If a tangent and a secant are drawn from a common point outside the circle then,

Tengent² = line of secant × (line of sacant - chord) 

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b012d87457e9a8d876c008c8ba7fdb824a17e6790afdb62fcfb360fa4701e99.png] 

From tangent and secant relation:

⇒ KH² = KD × KE

⇒ KH² = 9 × 16

⇒ KH = √144 = 12 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm. **
